## Background

A new RUSTSEC advisory is currently ignored in `deny.toml`:

**RUSTSEC-2026-0344**: Decompression bomb in ruzstd: a tiny input can exhaust memory (OOM)

This affects `ruzstd` 0.8.3, which is a transitive dependency via:

```
bevy → bevy_image → ruzstd
```

## Current Status

- `ruzstd` 0.8.3 (used by `bevy_image`) is vulnerable
- Fix requires `ruzstd` 0.9.1+
- The `zstd_rust` feature in `bevy_image` is optional and not enabled by default
- No pre-release of `bevy` with the fixed `bevy_image`/`ruzstd` is available on crates.io

## Checklist for Removal

- [ ] `bevy_image` updates to use `ruzstd` >= 0.9.1
- [ ] `bevy` updates to use the fixed `bevy_image` version
- [ ] Delta-V updates `bevy` dependency in `Cargo.toml`
- [ ] Remove `RUSTSEC-2026-0344` from ignore list in `deny.toml`
- [ ] Run `cargo deny check --hide-inclusion-graph` to verify no other advisories
- [ ] Close this issue

## Monitoring

Watch these repositories for releases:

- https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy (bevy_image / bevy)
- https://github.com/byron/rzstd
